sources.title: React Three Fiber v10 Migration Guide
sources.version_or_scope: Current v10 deployment; alpha at retrieval
sources.evidence_summary: v10 deployment; explicitly marked alpha; documents WebGPU default Canvas, /legacy for GLSL, three >=0.185.0 and React >=19.0 <19.4; documents frame scheduler and API changes.
